observation.pattern: The same two canonical GitHub references were repeatedly presented; the assistant repeatedly attempted the same unavailable independent-web readback and returned the same NOT_PROVEN state.

lesson.statement: Once repetition establishes a stable no-progress transition, further identical retries are not progress and must be replaced by an alternate verifier, a typed external HOLD, or an evidence-bound successor.
lesson.epistemic_boundary: Failure of one independent web channel does not negate repository persistence; it only leaves that distinct verification predicate open.
